WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 4 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks,
           COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.stores, ty.store_weeks, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region NULLS FIRST;

WITH rng AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, MIN(calendar_date) a, MAX(calendar_date) b FROM dim_date
  WHERE (fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 4) OR (fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 4) GROUP BY 1
),
dups AS (
  SELECT r.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS d_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id||'-'||f.line_no) AS d_rl,
         SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_all
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN rng r ON f.sale_date BETWEEN r.a AND r.b GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT r.fiscal_year, SUM(c.net_sales) AS ctl_net, SUM(CASE WHEN c.store_id<900 THEN c.net_sales END) AS ctl_phys
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN rng r ON c.business_date BETWEEN r.a AND r.b GROUP BY 1
),
rets AS (
  SELECT r.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT x.return_line_id) d, SUM(x.refund_net) refunds
  FROM fact_return_line x JOIN rng r ON x.return_date BETWEEN r.a AND r.b GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT d.*, c.ctl_net, c.ctl_phys, t.n AS ret_rows, t.d AS ret_distinct, t.refunds FROM dups d JOIN ctl c USING(fiscal_year) JOIN rets t USING(fiscal_year);

WITH rng AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, MIN(calendar_date) a, MAX(calendar_date) b FROM dim_date
  WHERE fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1
),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
nl AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dd, f.sale_date) AS bd, s.store_id, f.net_amount v
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (SELECT r.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.v) mine FROM nl n JOIN rng r ON n.bd BETWEEN r.a AND r.b GROUP BY 1,2),
ctl AS (SELECT r.fiscal_year, c.store_id, SUM(c.net_sales) ctl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN rng r ON c.business_date BETWEEN r.a AND r.b GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT st.store_id, st.store_name, st.region, st.open_date, st.close_date,
  m1.mine AS ty_mine, c1.ctl AS ty_ctl, m0.mine AS ly_mine, c0.ctl AS ly_ctl,
  ROUND(100.0*(m1.mine/m0.mine-1),1) AS g
FROM dim_store st
LEFT JOIN mine m1 ON m1.store_id=st.store_id AND m1.fiscal_year='FY2026/27'
LEFT JOIN ctl c1 ON c1.store_id=st.store_id AND c1.fiscal_year='FY2026/27'
LEFT JOIN mine m0 ON m0.store_id=st.store_id AND m0.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
LEFT JOIN ctl c0 ON c0.store_id=st.store_id AND c0.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id<900
ORDER BY st.store_id;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 4 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (

lfl_store_weeks AS (

    JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current

lfl_sales AS (

    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)

SELECT params.ty_year AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_period,

FROM params
